title: Settings sync
loadFailed: Couldn't load instances or the master profile

master.title: Master profile
master.none: No master profile yet. Capture one from an instance or edit it manually
master.overwriteContent: Capturing replaces the current master profile with the selected instance's game settings. Manual edits will be lost.

preview.noChanges: The selected instances already match the master profile

apply.title: Sync settings?
apply.content: {changes} settings will change in {targets} instances. Each file is backed up first, and you can undo it next to the instance.

restore.title: Undo the last sync for {name}?
restore.content: The instance's game settings will be replaced with the latest backup. Undoing again restores an earlier backup.

editor.title: Edit master profile
editor.hint: Use the 1.13+ format, e.g. key bindings as key_key.jump = key.keyboard.space. Values are converted automatically for older versions.
